mapper.select: SELECT CAST(AVG(O_lon) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) AS startLon, CAST(AVG(O_lat) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) AS startLat, CAST(AVG(D_lon) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) AS endLon, CAST(AVG(D_lat) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) AS endLat, COUNT(1) AS weight FROM (SELECT CAST(lon ->>'$[0]' AS DECIMAL(18,6)) AS O_lon, CAST(lat ->>'$[0]' AS DECIMAL(18,6)) AS O_lat, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(lon, CONCAT('$[', JSON_LENGTH(lon) - 1, ']')) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) AS D_lon, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(lat, CONCAT('$[', JSON_LENGTH(lat) - 1, ']')) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) AS D_lat FROM trips WHERE created_at >= #{param1} AND created_at <= #{param2}) AS od_data WHERE O_lon IS NOT NULL AND D_lon IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ST_GeoHash(O_lon, O_lat, 6), ST_GeoHash(D_lon, D_lat, 6) HAVING -- 💡 修复：在 HAVING 的聚合函数外层，强制将 AVG 结果转为 DOUBLE ST_GeoHash(CAST(AVG(O_lon) AS DOUBLE), CAST(AVG(O_lat) AS DOUBLE), 6) <> ST_GeoHash(CAST(AVG(D_lon) AS DOUBLE), CAST(AVG(D_lat) AS DOUBLE), 6) ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT #{param3}
